method: Pairs of finishes within 5 seconds of each other at all nine timing points in the start-screened editions (154,113 pairs of different linked records; pairs identical at all nine points left out), keyed by their two linked records (149,353 keys); every later start-screened edition that both records finished (14,625), and whether the two finishes were in step at all nine points again. The comparison column does the same for pairs of linked records within 5 seconds at the finish but 30 seconds or more apart at some mat (9,188,042 keys, 2,448,654 later shared editions, 432 in step). Records linked by name are candidates, not verified people.
